title: Gremlin
description: A mod adding two items, making squids slightly more useful
body:
# Gremlin
Gremlin adds 2 new items a bottle of ink, which is gathered by right clicking a squid with a glass bottle, and a bowl of squid created with a bowl and ink sac

## Bottle of ink
the bottle of ink can be thrown to blind other players it doesnt last long but is a nice distraction
